tags.description:
This resource supports [app migrations](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/app-migration/). Use it to:
- [to request migrated workflow rules details](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/app-migration/tutorials/migration-app-workflow-rules/).
- [perform bulk updates of entity properties](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/app-migration/tutorials/entity-properties-bulk-api/).
- [perform bulk updates of issue custom field values](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/app-migration/tutorials/migrating-app-custom-fields/).
tags.name: App migration

tags.description: This resource supports the migration of some Connect modules to their equivalent Forge modules.

get.description:
Returns all modules registered dynamically by the calling app.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** Only Connect apps can make this request.

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

example.message: The request is not from a Connect app.

401.description: Returned if the call is not from a Connect app.

post.description:
Registers a list of modules.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** Only Connect apps can make this request.

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

example.message: Installation failed. The app com.example.app.key has duplicate module keys: [module-key]. Please contact the app vendor.

400.description:
Returned if:
* any of the provided modules is invalid. For example, required properties are missing.
* any of the modules conflict with registered dynamic modules or modules defined in the app descriptor. For example, there are duplicate keys.

Details of the issues encountered are included in the error message.

example.message: The request is not from a Connect app.

401.description: Returned if the call is not from a Connect app.

delete.description:
Remove all or a list of modules registered by the calling app.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** Only Connect apps can make this request.

parameters.description:
The key of the module to remove. To include multiple module keys, provide multiple copies of this parameter.
For example, `moduleKey=dynamic-attachment-entity-property&moduleKey=dynamic-select-field`.
Nonexistent keys are ignored.
parameters.name: moduleKey

204.description: Returned if the request is successful.

example.message: The request is not from a Connect app.

401.description: Returned if the call is not from a Connect app.

get.description:
Returns the details of a Connect issue field's migration to Forge.

When migrating a Connect app to Forge, [Issue Field](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/software/modules/issue-field/) modules
must be converted to [Custom field](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/manifest-reference/modules/jira-custom-field/). When the
Forge version of the app is installed, Forge creates a
[background task](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-tasks/#api-group-tasks) to track the
migration of field data across. This endpoint returns the status and other details of that background task.

For more details, see
[Jira modules > Jira Custom Fields](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/adopting-forge-from-connect/migrate-jira-custom-fields/).

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** Only Connect and Forge apps can make this request.

parameters.description: The key of the Connect app that contains the Jira issue field being migrated.
parameters.name: connectKey

parameters.description: The module key of the Connect issue field being migrated.
parameters.name: jiraIssueFieldsKey

200.description: Returned if the request is successful and a migration task is found.

example.message: Access to this resource must be authenticated as an app.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

example.message: No ongoing migration task for the custom field.

404.description:
Returned if:
* no migrated Forge module with the given key is found.
* no ongoing migration task exists for the custom field.

get.summary: Get Connect issue field migration task
tags: Migration of Connect modules to Forge

post.description:
Submits a request to trigger migration of connect issue field to its Forge custom field counterpart.

When migrating a Connect app to Forge, [Issue Field](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/software/modules/issue-field/) modules
must be converted to [Custom field](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/manifest-reference/modules/jira-custom-field/) modules.
This endpoint triggers the background migration of field data. Use the GET endpoint to retrieve
the status and progress of the task.

For more details, see
[Jira modules > Jira Custom Fields](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/adopting-forge-from-connect/migrate-jira-custom-fields/).

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** Only Connect and Forge apps can make this request.

parameters.description: The key of the Connect app that contains the Jira issue field being migrated.
parameters.name: connectKey

parameters.description: The module key of the Connect issue field being migrated.
parameters.name: jiraIssueFieldsKey

parameters.description: Whether to retrigger the migration if it has already completed.
parameters.name: retriggerCompletedMigration

202.description: Returned if the migration task was submitted successfully.

example.message: Access to this resource must be authenticated as an app.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

example.message: No migrated Forge module with given key is found.

404.description: Returned if no migrated Forge module with the given key is found.

example.message: Failed to trigger migration task because of already in progress task for the field.

409.description: Returned if a migration task is already in progress for the field.

post.summary: Submit Connect issue field migration task
tags: Migration of Connect modules to Forge

put.description:
Updates the value of a custom field added by Connect apps on one or more issues.
The values of up to 200 custom fields can be updated.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** Only Connect apps can make this request

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is invalid.

403.description:
Returned if:
* the transfer ID is not found.
* the authorisation credentials are incorrect or missing.

put.description: Updates the values of multiple entity properties for an object, up to 50 updates per request. This operation is for use by Connect apps during app migration.

parameters.description: The type indicating the object that contains the entity properties.
parameters.name: entityType

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is not valid.

403.description: Returned if the authorisation credentials are incorrect or missing.

post.description: Returns configurations for workflow transition rules migrated from server to cloud and owned by the calling Connect app.

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is not valid.

403.description: Returned if the authorisation credentials are incorrect or missing.

get.description:
Retrieve the attributes of given service registries.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** Only Connect apps can make this request and the servicesIds belong to the tenant you are requesting

parameters.description: The ID of the services (the strings starting with "b:" need to be decoded in Base64).
parameters.name: serviceIds

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is invalid.

401.description: The request needs to be authenticated.

501.description: The endpoint isn't ready for receiving requests.

get.summary: Retrieve the attributes of service registries

id.description: The ID of the transition rule.

key.description: The key of the rule, as defined in the Connect or the Forge app descriptor.

ConnectCustomFieldValue.description: A list of custom field details.

number.description: The value of number type custom field when `_type` is `NumberIssueField`.

optionID.description: The value of single select and multiselect custom field type when `_type` is `SingleSelectIssueField` or `MultiSelectIssueField`.

richText.description: The value of richText type custom field when `_type` is `RichTextIssueField`.

string.description: The value of string type custom field when `_type` is `StringIssueField`.

text.description: The value of of text custom field type when `_type` is `TextIssueField`.

ConnectCustomFieldValues.description: Details of updates for a custom field.

updateValueList.description: The list of custom field update details.

ConnectModule.description:
A [Connect module](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/about-jira-modules/) in the same format as in the
[app descriptor](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/app-descriptor/).

modules.description:
A list of app modules in the same format as the `modules` property in the
[app descriptor](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/app-descriptor/).

value.description: The new value of the entity property.

example.message: The request is not from a Connect app.

message.description: The human-readable message that describes the result.

statusCode.description: The status code of the response.

tag.description: A tag used to filter rules in [Get workflow transition rule configurations](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-workflow-transition-rules/#api-rest-api-3-workflow-rule-config-get).

value.description: Configuration of the rule, as it is stored by the Connect or the Forge app on the rule configuration page.

elapsedRuntime.description: The execution time of the task, in milliseconds.

finished.description: A timestamp recording when the task was finished.

lastUpdate.description: A timestamp recording when the task progress was last updated.

message.description: Information about the progress of the task.

progress.description: The progress of the task, as a percentage complete.

result.description: The result of the task execution.

started.description: A timestamp recording when the task was started.

submitted.description: A timestamp recording when the task was submitted.

submittedBy.description: The ID of the user who submitted the task.

draft.description: **Deprecated:** Whether the workflow is in the draft state. The 'draft' parameter will be removed from this API on [November 2, 2026](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/changelog/#CHANGE-3147).

WorkflowRulesSearch.description: Details of the workflow and its transition rules.

expand.description: Use expand to include additional information in the response. This parameter accepts `transition` which, for each rule, returns information about the transition the rule is assigned to.

ruleIds.description: The list of workflow rule IDs.

invalidRules.description: List of workflow rule IDs that do not belong to the workflow or can not be found.

validRules.description: List of valid workflow transition rules.

conditions.description: The list of conditions within the workflow.

postFunctions.description: The list of post functions within the workflow.

validators.description: The list of validators within the workflow.

basicAuth.description: You can access this resource via basic auth.

scopes.delete:project:jira: Delete projects and their details, such as issue types, project lead, and avatars.
scopes.manage:jira-configuration: Configure Jira settings that require the Jira administrators permission, for example, create projects and custom fields, view workflows, manage issue link types.
scopes.manage:jira-project: Create and edit project settings and create new project-level objects, for example, versions, components.
scopes.manage:jira-webhook: Manage Jira webhooks. Enables an OAuth app to register and unregister dynamic webhooks in Jira. It also provides for fetching of registered webhooks.
scopes.read:email-address:jira: View email addresses of all users regardless of the user's profile visibility settings.
scopes.read:jira-user: View user information in Jira that you have access to, including usernames, email addresses, and avatars.
scopes.read:jira-work: Read project and issue data. Search for issues and objects associated with issues (such as attachments and worklogs).
scopes.write:avatar:jira: Create and update system and custom avatars.
scopes.write:comment.property:jira: Create and update issue comment properties.
scopes.write:field-configuration-scheme:jira: Create and update field configuration schemes.
scopes.write:field.default-value:jira: Create and update field default values.
scopes.write:filter.default-share-scope:jira: Create and update filter default share scopes.
scopes.write:issue-link-type:jira: Create and update issue link types.
scopes.write:issue-type-scheme:jira: Create and update issue type schemes.
scopes.write:issue-type-screen-scheme:jira: Create and update issue type screen schemes.
scopes.write:issue-type.property:jira: Create and update issue type properties.
scopes.write:issue-worklog.property:jira: Create and update issue worklog properties.
scopes.write:issue.remote-link:jira: Create and update issue remote links.
scopes.write:issue.time-tracking:jira: Create and update issue time trackings.
scopes.write:jira-work: Create and edit issues in Jira, post comments, create worklogs, and delete issues.
